about: How each mob, scene and portrait was made, so the set can be made again (node scripts/generate-icons.mjs --set art). See "Art" in docs/design.md. An image with "generated": null has not been made yet.

style.name: Lantern-lit linocut
style.mobPrompt: Game bestiary illustration: exactly one {subject}, whole body in view, shown alone, turned to face the left. Style: hand-carved linocut print illustration, bold black ink outlines, flat colour fills with carved line hatching, limited palette of parchment cream, warm amber, rust red and deep teal. A soft warm amber glow behind the creature. Plain solid very dark brown background, no scenery. The creature fills most of the picture with a small margin on every side. No text, no letters, no border, no frame.
style.scenePrompt: Game location illustration, wide view at dusk: {subject}. Style: hand-carved linocut print illustration, bold black ink outlines, flat colour fills with carved line hatching, limited palette of parchment cream, warm amber, rust red and deep teal. Dark sky, deep shadows, light only from the low sun or a lantern. The lower middle of the picture is open ground with nothing important on it. No people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no border, no frame.
